classes.name: VoxelBuffer
classes.evidence: 46 canonical #[func] methods (43 real: create/set/get/fill/fill_area/clear/is_uniform/compress/decompress/copy_channel/downscale/byte_array/mirror/rotate_90/remap/op_add/sub/min/max/paste/get_size/get_voxel_f/set_voxel_f/get_voxel_v/set_voxel_v/get_channel_depth/set_channel_depth/get_channel_compression/get_allocator plus in-memory block/voxel metadata). Remaining stubs: get_voxel_tool, 2 texture methods, 1 debug method. Variant serializer codec is still deferred. + 29 #[constant] declarations + behavioral tests (api_test.gd, parity_suite). Status partial because a few methods lack matching observable behavior.

classes.name: VoxelLodTerrain
classes.evidence: Registered and now a real runtime: owns a VoxelTerrainCore built via new_variable_lod, drives try_process through the production Variable LOD planner, consumes mesh lifecycle and RenderTopologyChanged events (u_transition_mask), uploads ArrayMeshes, and can emit regular-only collision surfaces when generate_collisions is on. Debug-draw flags rebuild a wireframe overlay (clipbox leaves, volume bounds, viewer clipboxes, edited/metadata boxes). 3-LOD paging is exercised by variable_lod_3. GPU/normalmap inspector fields remain stored stubs.
